article: All-ASA Aero magnetic float, paused RC62 insertion trial v1
launch_condition: One submission is accepted. At the native magnet pause, seat one RC62 fully below both pocket rims before manual resume. No automatic resume or further submission is authorized.
user_request: After this print, which seems to be going well, I'd like you to design a print that is an entirely ASA Aero float, paused halfway through for magnet insertion, and then continue to print on top of that.
scope: Single body bench trial. Insert one RC62 at the native pause before resuming. Printed adhesion, retention, magnet heat exposure, density, buoyancy and service qualification are unverified.
bed_clear_confirmation: I am ready for the next print on mark2. Bed is clear.
monitor_status: The existing follow-up is paused by the user.

magnet_insertion_estimate.basis: Native initial M73 C56 time-to-pause and M73 R31 at the end of layer 79 in the 88-minute slice; actual warm-up and calibration can shift wall-clock timing.
magnet_insertion_estimate.scope: Approximate wall-clock estimate; startup heating, calibration and firmware motion can shift arrival. The native pause waits for manual magnet insertion and resume.

operator_reported_progress: Paused RC62 insertion and initial overprint reported successful; first covering layer tight, second deposited well.
